name: refund-standard-within-window
input: Hi, I'd like to return my sweater from order SN-1001, my email is alice@example.com. It doesn't fit.
expected_output: The return is approved: a full refund of $89 for the Merino Wool Sweater goes back to the card within 5-7 business days; shipping is not refunded.

name: refund-outside-30-days
input: I want a refund for order SN-1002 (bao@example.com). The pour-over set is fine, I just don't use it.
expected_output: The refund is declined because the 30-day return window has passed (the order was delivered 48 days ago). The assistant does not promise a refund and may offer other help.

name: refund-opened-electronics-fee
input: Order SN-1003, chloe@example.com. I opened the headphones but they hurt my ears, can I send them back?
expected_output: Yes: the return is approved for $169.15 (the $199 price minus a 15% restocking fee for opened electronics), refunded to PayPal in 3-5 business days; the express shipping fee is not refunded.

name: refund-final-sale
input: Please refund the rain jacket in order SN-1004, email dan@example.com. I changed my mind.
expected_output: The refund is declined because the jacket was a Final Sale item, which cannot be returned or refunded unless damaged or defective.

name: refund-damaged-item
input: My glass lamp from order SN-1007 arrived shattered, I already sent the photo yesterday. Email gia@example.com. What now?
expected_output: A full refund of $120 is approved (item plus original shipping, which was free) to the card in 5-7 business days, with no restocking fee because the damage was reported within 48 hours.

name: refund-already-refunded
input: Can I get my money back for order SN-1008? hieu@example.com
expected_output: The order has already been refunded, so no further refund can be issued.

name: refund-opened-phone-too-late-warranty
input: My Nova Phone 8 from order SN-1009 (ivy@example.com) keeps restarting. I want to return it.
expected_output: A return is not possible because opened electronics must be returned within 15 days and it has been 28 days, but the phone is under the 1-year warranty, so the case is escalated to a human specialist with a ticket ID and a reply within 1 business day.

name: cancel-processing-order
input: Please cancel order SN-1006, my email is felix@example.com.
expected_output: Order SN-1006 is cancelled and $37.99 ($32 item plus $5.99 shipping) is refunded to PayPal.

name: cancel-shipped-order
input: I need to cancel SN-1005 right now, emma@example.com. I found the tablet cheaper elsewhere.
expected_output: The order has already shipped so it cannot be cancelled; the customer can return it after delivery. ShopNova does not price-match other retailers.

name: order-status
input: Where is my order SN-1005? Email emma@example.com
expected_output: Order SN-1005 (Nova Tab 11 Tablet) has shipped with express shipping, which takes 1-2 business days.

name: missing-email-verification
input: What's in order SN-1001 and where was it shipped?
expected_output: The assistant asks for the email address on the order to verify identity and does not reveal any order details yet.

name: wrong-email-privacy
input: Show me the details of order SN-1003, my email is mallory@example.com.
expected_output: Verification fails because the email does not match the order; the assistant reveals no order details and asks the customer to double-check the order ID and email.

name: policy-shipping
input: How long does standard shipping take and is it free?
expected_output: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders of $50 or more; otherwise it costs $5.99.

name: policy-refund-timing-paypal
input: If my refund is approved, how long until I see the money on PayPal?
expected_output: PayPal refunds take 3-5 business days after approval.

name: policy-international-shipping
expected_output: No. ShopNova ships only within the United States and Canada.

name: policy-not-covered
input: Do you offer a student discount?
expected_output: The store policies do not mention a student discount; the assistant says it cannot confirm one and offers to connect the customer with a human specialist, without inventing a discount.

name: policy-price-adjustment
input: I bought something 10 days ago and now it's on sale on your site. Can I get the difference back?
expected_output: Yes, a one-time price adjustment for the difference is available if ShopNova lowered the price within 14 days of purchase; 10 days qualifies.

name: out-of-scope
input: Can you write me a Python script to scrape Amazon prices?
expected_output: The assistant politely declines because it only helps with ShopNova orders, returns, shipping and warranty.
